profile.subtitleJa: 教会の一部を苦しめ始めたヘロデ王。
profile.summaryJa: 使徒言行録12:1は、教会の一部を苦しめ始めた「ヘロデ王」を記す。本文の初出箇所は王の名をそれ以上詳しく示さない。
profile.identityNoteJa: この人物は歴史資料・記事で通常ヘロデ・アグリッパ1世と同定されるが、使徒言行録12:1のWEB本文自体は「ヘロデ王」とだけ記す。ヘロデ一族には複数の支配者がいるため、本文の直接呼称と資料上の同定を区別する。

facts.textJa: ヘロデ王はヨハネの兄弟ヤコブを剣で殺した。
王はユダヤ人たちに喜ばれたのを見て、ペトロも捕らえた。
ペトロが見つからないと、王は番兵を取り調べ、カイサリアへ下った。
王は公の場で演説し、民衆の歓声を受けた。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.
The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.
When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.”
When Herod had sought for him and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.

Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.
On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.

review.identityCheckJa: ACT 12章はこの人物をKing Herodと呼ぶ。プロフィールのHerod Agrippa I同定はWikipedia等の歴史的二次資料に基づく慣用同定であり、WEB ACT 12:1の語句そのものから王朝名・支配地域を取り出さない。
review.spoilerCheckJa: subtitleJa・summaryJaは初出12:1の直接呼称と行為に限定。後続の拘束・死などはknownBy付きfactsに分離。
